generation.author: OpenAI Codex gpt-6.1-sol, hand-written per item
generation.temperature_note: Not exposed by the coding harness; every stimulus was written as complete item-specific prose without templates or external LLM calls.
generation.prompt: Hand-write 20 realistic English offers across distinct domains and reader roles. For each write complete reasonable, excessive, number_low, and number_high texts. Reasonable/excessive must differ only in the cost numeral; number_low/high must differ only in the matching catalog numeral without monetary meaning. Change only sentence two between the cost and catalog controls, preserve every other fact and invitation, align its starting word index, and keep all lengths within two words. No sentences or extended phrase sequences may repeat across offers.

manipulation_check.classifier_model: claude-sonnet (Anthropic; different family from the GPT generator)
manipulation_check.classifier_prompt: Label each shuffled text without hypotheses or ROI names. S2/S4: Fact, How, Why; S1: generic or situation-specific; S3: reasonable or excessive cost, or number-only. Record labels and errors before freezing stimuli.
manipulation_check.failure_policy: Rewrite failed items before freezing; failed families are uninformative.
manipulation_check.classifier_result: 80/80 blind labels matched the intended condition
manipulation_check.owner_reviewer: delegated supervisor review (Claude Opus 5.5) under the owner's explicit 2026-10-16 instruction to decide without asking; owner may re-review

inference.primary_test: one-sided sign-flip; exact n<=16, Monte Carlo B=10000 otherwise
inference.reverse_test: two-sided sign-flip, Holm within the same group
inference.bootstrap: paired percentile mean CI95, B=2000, seed=0
inference.pass: expected mean direction, p_holm<.05, abs(median_delta)>ROI mdd, parcel_rank>=.90
inference.positive_control: S2 required for downstream informative statuses; never gates product features
inference.effect_warning: In-silico dz generalizes across authored stimuli, not human subjects.

modality.input: direct synthetic read-aloud at 2.5 words/s, no punctuation pauses
modality.primary: whole-text signed time mean; bidirectional encoder
modality.secondary_window: cost sentence to end, expanded +/-1 segment, minimum 4 segments; descriptive only

prior: Passive reading may be null: price effects depend on subjective willingness to pay; forced Plassmann bids had no desired correlation.
anatomical_notes: Primary vmPFC; secondary right insula is the right-hemisphere subset of WS07 insula indices, reported only. No OR rule or value ladder.
reports: Cost sentence-to-end window is secondary; reward_affect/emotional_engagement decoupling; right dlPFC only if a mapped location exists
